name: test-double-fidelity
description: Actor reviews an already-written test that mocks a cheap, real, in-memory scaler and model (StandardScaler/CheckpointedRegressor) instead of using them directly, and reports or fixes what it finds. This is testing-craft's own 'audit an existing test suite' direct-invocation shape, not an implement-and-test task that would naturally route through build-change instead -- so staging testing-craft alone is a fair test of whether it changes what the actor notices.
